title: Characteristic registry
description: List of the Characteristics the questionnaire measures. A Characteristic is a trait or experience that Questions add evidence to; the score is a number from -1 to 1 computed per Characteristic.

id.description: Unique snake_case identifier, at most 7 words. Referenced by Questions (characteristics[].id) and Profiles (characteristics[]).

name.description: Short label shown to the user in results, at most 14 words.

description.description: Plain-language explanation of what the Characteristic is and what a high score means, at most 39 words.

domain.description: The Domain the Characteristic belongs to. Questions are filed under the Domain of their main (highest absolute weight) Characteristic, and the engine prefers staying in the same Domain.

source.description: Where the concept was inspired, absorbed, adapted or used directly from: the most scientific reference that names or organises it, or exactly 'no reference' when none was found. At most 19 words.
